question: Where’s the closest stadium reachable in the east direction from New Mexico Slaughter House, Albuquerque, NM?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry AS origin_geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1 ), all_stadiums AS ( SELECT id, poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'stadium' UNION ALL SELECT id, park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'stadium' ) SELECT s.name FROM all_stadiums s, origin o WHERE degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.origin_geom::geography, ST_Centroid(s.geometry)::geography)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5 -- East direction ORDER BY ST_Distance(o.origin_geom::geography, ST_Centroid(s.geometry)::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
